children: On November 20, 2026, enCore Energy received notice from Nasdaq that its common shares had closed below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, violating Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company has until May 19, 2027, to regain compliance by maintaining a bid price of at least $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days; the notice has no immediate impact on its Nasdaq listing.
